payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the criteria used to select the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations, including their functional implications and structural effects on proteins.

claims.text: The top 10 nonsynonymous mutations were selected based on their effects on amino acid residues and potential functional interactions.
Mutations ORF1a nsp5 P108S, ORF3a Q57H, and N protein P151L were identified as potentially deleterious to SARS-CoV-2 protein function.
The selection criteria included the high concurrence ratio of many nonsynonymous mutations, indicating potential functional interactions.
